“青山，你说真的还是假的？不收诊金？”

“你耳朵聋了啊，青山都说了，暂时不收诊金，只收成本的药品费用。”

“青山，老叔打小就看你行啊，果然没有让叔失望！”

“青山，那你这可是为咱们村子干了一件好事情，保健站的大夫我看是非你莫属，那保健站的房间你爱怎么处理就怎么处理，我们都支持你，更何况还是帮主王乃香这种好事情，那我们就更应该支持你了。”

石溪村的百姓顿时变了样，纷纷开口道。

这一波操作，李青山直接从村子里的二流子，摇身一变，成为了准大夫。

站在李青山身旁的王乃香，则是一脸敬仰的望着李青山。

真没想到，李青山不仅上山打猎厉害，竟然还会医术，真是太厉害了。

“李青山……我的胳膊，我的胳膊还没正上呢！”

“快点！”

赵贵等的有些着急了起来，急忙蹭到李青山面前道。

“你？”

“呵呵，自己去乡诊所正吧，我怕一不小心，把你另外一个胳膊也给卸掉了。”

李青山朝着赵贵狠狠瞪了一眼，再次拉着王乃香朝着村子里的保健站赶了过去。

“哎呦，我的老天爷啊，欺负人啊，真是欺负人啊……！”赵贵顿时撒泼的倒在地上，朝着李青山大骂道：“李青山，你给我等着，我赵贵绝对不会轻饶了你……！”

“爹，别叫了，咱们还是赶紧去乡诊所吧！”

李青山听着身后传来的声音，眼神中流露出一抹冷意。

一家子的畜生。

这么欺负王乃香一个外来的弱女子，还想让自己帮忙把他脱臼的胳膊接上去，想也不要想，刚刚自己恨不得把赵贵另外一条胳膊也给他卸掉了。

赵贵，你以为事情就这么简单完了吗？

那可真是太小看我李青山了。

"Qingshan, are you telling the truth or not? No medical fee?"

"You are deaf. Qingshan has already said that we will not charge consultation fees for the time being. We will only charge the cost of medicines."

"Qingshan, I've been watching you since I was a kid. I really didn't disappoint you!"

"Qingshan, then you have done a good thing for our village. I think you are the doctor at the health station. You can do whatever you want with the room at the health station. We all support you, not to mention it is a good thing like gang leader Wang Naixiang, so we should support you even more."

The people of Shixi Village suddenly changed their appearance and started talking one after another.

With this operation, Li Qingshan transformed from a second-rate man in the village to a quasi-doctor.

Wang Naixiang, who was standing next to Li Qingshan, looked at Li Qingshan with admiration.

I really didn’t expect that Li Qingshan was not only good at hunting in the mountains, but he also had medical skills. It was really amazing.

"Li Qingshan...my arm, my arm isn't up yet!"

"Hurry up!"

Zhao Gui became a little anxious while waiting, and hurriedly walked up to Li Qingshan and said.

"You?"

"Haha, go to the township clinic for treatment yourself. I'm afraid I might accidentally remove your other arm."

Li Qingshan glared at Zhao Gui fiercely, and once again pulled Wang Naixiang and rushed towards the health center in the village.

"Oh my God, you are bullying people, you are really bullying people...!" Zhao Gui suddenly fell to the ground and cursed at Li Qingshan: "Li Qingshan, just wait for me, I, Zhao Gui, will never let you off lightly...!"

"Dad, stop screaming, let's go to the township clinic quickly!"

Li Qingshan listened to the voice coming from behind, with a hint of coldness in his eyes.

A family of beasts.

He bullied Wang Naixiang, a weak foreign woman, and wanted to help him reattach his dislocated arm. He didn't even think about it. Just now, he wanted to remove Zhao Gui's other arm.

Zhao Gui, do you think things are that simple?

That is really underestimating me, Li Qingshan.
